title: chloris polydactyla
intro: Chloris polydactyla, commonly known as the Six-stamened Tridens or Tridens, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in India and Southeast Asia, due to its purported health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Chloris polydactyla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. These bioactive compounds are believed to contribute to the plant's potential health benefits, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human consumption.
